info.name: Game Platform API
info.description:
Complete production REST collection for Game Platform API.

**Base URL:** `https://game-api.maxlived.net/api/v1`

Covers every HTTP route mounted under `/api/v1`:
- Health, Admin auth/users/policy/approvals
- Analytics, Platform apps/users, Wallets
- Platform integrations
- Player + Admin surfaces for Greedy, Greedy Classic, Lucky 77, Teen Patti (lifecycle, config, ops, assets, rounds)

### Setup
1. Import this collection + `Game_Platform_Production.postman_environment.json`
2. Set `admin_email` / `admin_password`
3. Run **Admin Login** first
4. For player routes, set `user_id` (and ensure identity header is allowed or use real player auth)
5. For integrations, set platform app credentials
